research_question: Owner-approved addition: 9 Best Lawyer Time Tracking Software Tools for Billable Work. Verify every product fact and price in the owner draft against official vendor pages.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for lawyer time tracking software, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Law firm owners, legal operations staff, and legal teams in the United States.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Claims the vendor pages did not support were corrected or cut; WiseTime $360 price cut (not in page text); Rocket Matter starting price corrected from $39 (a CRM add-on) to $59; TimeSolv $49 starting price cut (plan prices not in page text; $147 figure is a marketing add-on); Smokeball overnight-entry claim cut.

content_gaps: Top results are mostly single-vendor pages that do not compare published prices on one date.
Few ranking pages show the arithmetic behind a total monthly cost.
value_add: A same-day check of nine vendors' published prices and capture features, with stale draft prices corrected, plus a worked five-user monthly cost table built only from printed rates.

plan.seo_title: 9 Best Lawyer Time Tracking Software Tools for 2026
plan.meta_description: Compare nine lawyer time tracking software tools by passive capture, timers, mobile entry, billing links, privacy controls, published pricing, and firm fit.
outline: 1. WiseTime: Best for Private Passive Desktop Capture
2. Smokeball AutoTime: Best for Automatic Capture Inside Smokeball
3. MyCase: Best Mix of Timers and Missed-Time Review
4. Clio: Best Broad Practice Management Workflow
5. TimeSolv: Best for Detailed Time and E-Billing
7. LeanLaw: Best for QuickBooks Online Firms
9. Rocket Matter: Best for Flexible Rates and Batch Billing
What Five Users Cost Per Month at Published Rates
